python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0061.png"))
# Find baseboard in obs_0061 (white wall vs gray floor)
for v in range(300, 450):
    if not np.array_equal(img[v, 100], [255, 255, 255]):
        print(f"Baseboard at v={v}: {img[v, 100]}")
        break

# And find bottle top / cap center
# Blue bottle
blue_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 150) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50)
v_indices, u_indices = np.where(blue_mask)
print(f"Bottle blue pixels: u from {u_indices.min()} to {u_indices.max()}, v from {v_indices.min()} to {v_indices.max()}")
print(f"Bottle center u: {(u_indices.min() + u_indices.max()) / 2.0}")
'
